answer_1.quote: We also propose REBOT, a multi-session conversation model, REBOT (REmember ChatBOT). REBOT consists of two parts: the chronological summarization module and the dialogue generation module.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to verify the quality of our CONVERSATION CHRONICLES (see Section 5 for the evaluation details). We sample 5K episodes and ask evaluators to rate each of them based on four criteria (coherence, consistency, time interval, and relationship).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are asked to rate the generated outputs based on specific criteria such as coherence, consistency, time interval, and relationship.
